# TinyOrder

> TinyOrder is online ordering software for **home businesses and small independent sellers** —
> home kitchens and bakers first, and equally anyone selling what they make: handmade goods, crafts,
> art, clothing. Each shop gets its own storefront link, its own product list and its own order
> list. TinyOrder charges a flat subscription and takes **no commission** on orders; customers pay
> the shop directly and TinyOrder never handles the money. The dashboard and every storefront work
> in both English and Chinese.

TinyOrder is **software a shop runs itself**, not a marketplace and not a delivery app. There is no
shared customer marketplace to be listed in, no rider network, and no payment processing — the shop
shares its own link, shows its own payment instructions, and is paid directly.

Who it is for: anyone selling their own products direct to customers and currently taking orders by
hand in WhatsApp groups, Instagram DMs or Google Forms. Food is where most shops start — home
bakers, home kitchens, frozen-food and meal-prep sellers, market stalls, small cafés — and nothing
in the product is food-only: a maker selling craft, art, clothing or any other small-batch goods
uses the same storefront, the same delivery pricing and the same order list.

What a shop gets: a storefront page with photos, prices and per-unit pricing (per piece, box, set,
pack, dozen, bottle, jar, tray, slice, kg or g); product names and descriptions in English, Chinese
or both; delivery fees that are flat, by region, or a base fee plus a rate per kilometre of real
road distance from the shop's address;
pickup, delivery or both; numbered orders in one list with the customer's name, WhatsApp number,
items, wanted date and total; order status (preparing / ready / done); customer self-service order
lookup by order number; an email alert on every order on every plan; and a customer list the shop
builds automatically from its orders.

Plans: **Basic** and **Pro**. Pro adds instant Telegram alerts, discount vouchers, promotional
prices on individual items, and priority support. Billing is monthly or yearly, with two months
free on yearly; amounts are shown per region on the pricing page and are deliberately not repeated
here. Basic starts with a **free 7-day trial that needs no card**; starting on Pro pays up front.
A shop and its order page go live the moment the owner signs up — there is no approval wait.
Cancel any time from the dashboard; the shop runs to the end of the paid period.

Each shop is served at `https://tinyorder.shop/s/<shop-slug>`. Shop slugs are chosen at signup and
are not listed here or in the sitemap — they appear and change without a deploy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tinyorder.shop/): what TinyOrder is, who it is for, and how a shop gets started
- [Features](https://tinyorder.shop/features): the storefront, delivery pricing, order handling, alerts, and the customer list, in full
- [Pricing](https://tinyorder.shop/pricing): current Basic and Pro amounts for your region, the full plan comparison, and the 7-day cardless trial
- [FAQ](https://tinyorder.shop/faq): cost, trial, how customers pay, whether a website is needed, what Pro adds, cancelling, Chinese support, and how fast a shop goes live
- [Sample shops](https://tinyorder.shop/sample-shops): real storefronts built on TinyOrder. The list is read from the database when the page opens, so it is not in the page source — follow the shop links from the page itself

## Start a shop

- [Sign up](https://tinyorder.shop/merchant/signup): create a shop; the storefront link is live immediately
- [Log in](https://tinyorder.shop/merchant/login): existing shop owners
